title: Two Adjacent Battle Lines
prompt:
正面青狮压黑鹫；侧面金鹿切青狮，黑鹫机动组压金鹿。 Youthful academy students, controlled nonlethal exercise, no UI.

Cinematic continuity: Block=Mock Battle Expanded Action. Transition in: continues Scene09 tactical action geography. Transition out: cuts to the next tactical action beat. Screen/camera rule: Blue Lions pressure expands from southeast/central lane; Golden Deer side pressure and Black Eagles adjustments remain geographically readable. Audio bridge: horn, training weapon clacks, bowstring, magic pressure, controlled breaths. Generate with 2s editorial handle where possible; begin and end with usable motion, not a frozen poster. Maintain direction, eyelines, and spatial geography from adjacent shots.

Youth/beauty guard: Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired. Show tactical pressure through blocking, posture, sound and editing rather than aging faces.

Camera: A tactical wide shows two adjacent battle lines: Dimitri-Dedue-Felix pressing Black Eagles at the central choke, and Sylvain-Ingrid-Ashe contesting Golden Deer near side obstacles while a Black Eagles mobile student threatens Golden Deer from another angle. The lines are close enough to affect each other but not a crowd pileup.

Scene09 production gate: do not generate final video from the blocked source image if it is SVG or legacy training-yard raster. Use production_image_path after a real cinematic raster keyframe is generated and QA-approved.
Character continuity gate: every named character must match the listed selected.png reference assets for face, hair, age, costume silhouette, and color accents.
negative_prompt: No game UI, no subtitles, no readable text, no watermark, no modern objects. No identity drift, face swaps, costume drift, extra limbs, warped hands, flickering faces, or sudden style changes. No middle-aged face unless canonically required, no old face, no wrinkles, no tired eye bags, no harsh pores, no weathered skin, no gaunt face, no matronly look, no gritty realism, no generic medieval extra. Keep academy students youthful, attractive, clean-skinned and official-game-inspired; use controlled academy sparring only, no blood or lethal injury. Avoid: game UI, text, watermark, lethal injury, blood, modern objects, old faces, wrong house colors, generic adult soldiers, separate small training yard
